JWT_SECRET_KEY.description: Signs Omlorix authentication tokens. Use a unique random value containing at least 64 bytes and keep it private.

PASSWORD_RESET_IDENTIFIER_HASH_SALT.description: Salt used to hash password reset identifiers for throttling and audit correlation. Change it for real deployments.

LOG_IP_HASH_SALT.description: Independent salt for stable pseudonymous audit and password-reset IP fingerprints. Do not reuse the JWT signing key.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Fernet key used to encrypt stored secrets such as API keys. Back it up securely; encrypted data cannot be recovered without it.

ALLOW_LOCAL_OR_PRIVATE_ORIGINS.description: Allow browser origins from localhost, loopback, or private IP addresses. Keep this off unless this server is intentionally reached from those origins.

DATABASE_USER.description: PostgreSQL username used by the bundled database and backend connection settings.

DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Password for the bundled PostgreSQL database. The launcher can generate it; rotate it before production use.

DATABASE_HOST.description: Host name or address the backend uses when connecting to PostgreSQL outside Docker-internal overrides.

DATABASE_PORT.description: PostgreSQL port used by host-facing tools and non-override backend settings.

DATABASE_NAME.description: Application database name used by Omlorix.

DATABASE_AUDIT_LOG_SCHEMA.description: PostgreSQL schema for audit log tables.

DATABASE_LOGS_SCHEMA.description: PostgreSQL schema for operational log tables.

OMLORIX_AUTO_CREATE_DATABASES.description: Controls automatic PostgreSQL database creation. Enabled by default; set false when the target database is provisioned externally.

DATABASE_HOST_OVERRIDE.description: Docker Compose internal PostgreSQL host override. Keep this pointed at the Compose service unless you know the container network layout.

DATABASE_PORT_OVERRIDE.description: Docker Compose internal PostgreSQL port override used by containers.

DATABASE_URL.description: External PostgreSQL connection URL used when the built-in database is off.

COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME.description: Docker Compose project name. Fresh Launcher and CLI homes receive a stable unique value automatically.

OMLORIX_VERSION.description: Omlorix server version deployed by the launcher. Pin to a reviewed release instead of a moving tag for stable deployments.

OMLORIX_USE_BUNDLED_DB.description: Start the built-in PostgreSQL service. Turn off only when using an external PostgreSQL database.

OMLORIX_USE_BUNDLED_REDIS.description: Use the built-in Redis service when Redis-backed features are enabled.

OMLORIX_USE_PGBOUNCER.description: Start PgBouncer to pool PostgreSQL connections for busier servers.

OMLORIX_USE_BUNDLED_STORAGE.description: Start built-in MinIO object storage. Turn off when using S3, GCS, Azure, WebDAV, or local file storage.

FRONTEND_HTTP_HOST_BIND.description: Network address for the HTTP frontend port. The default is 127.0.0.1; choose 0.0.0.0 only for intentional direct LAN/public access with an appropriate firewall, trusted-host policy, and reverse-proxy/TLS design.

FRONTEND_HTTP_HOST_PORT.description: Host port mapped to the frontend HTTP endpoint.

DEV_DATABASE_HOST_PORT.description: Host port exposed for the development PostgreSQL service.

DEV_REDIS_HOST_PORT.description: Host port exposed for the development Redis service.

PGBOUNCER_HOST_BIND.description: Address PgBouncer binds to on the host. Keep localhost unless exposing through a trusted network boundary.

MINIO_API_HOST_BIND.description: Address for the MinIO S3-compatible API on the host. Keep localhost unless protected by firewall, VPN, or proxy.

MINIO_API_HOST_PORT.description: Host port for the MinIO S3-compatible API.

MINIO_CONSOLE_HOST_BIND.description: Address for the MinIO admin console on the host. Keep localhost unless access is protected.

MINIO_CONSOLE_HOST_PORT.description: Host port for the MinIO admin console.

API_LB_TRAEFIK_WEB_HOST_PORT.description: Host port for the optional Traefik API load balancer.

API_LB_TRAEFIK_DASHBOARD_HOST_PORT.description: Host port for the optional Traefik dashboard.

OTEL_GRPC_HOST_BIND.description: Host bind address for the OpenTelemetry gRPC collector endpoint.

OTEL_GRPC_HOST_PORT.description: Host port for the OpenTelemetry gRPC collector endpoint.

OTEL_HTTP_HOST_BIND.description: Host bind address for the OpenTelemetry HTTP collector endpoint.

OTEL_HTTP_HOST_PORT.description: Host port for the OpenTelemetry HTTP collector endpoint.

OTEL_PROMETHEUS_HOST_BIND.description: Host bind address for the OpenTelemetry Prometheus exporter.

OTEL_PROMETHEUS_HOST_PORT.description: Host port for the OpenTelemetry Prometheus exporter.

OTEL_HEALTHCHECK_HOST_BIND.description: Host bind address for the OpenTelemetry collector health endpoint.

OTEL_HEALTHCHECK_HOST_PORT.description: Host port for the OpenTelemetry collector health endpoint.

JAEGER_UI_HOST_BIND.description: Host bind address for the Jaeger UI. Keep localhost unless protected.

JAEGER_UI_HOST_PORT.description: Host port for the Jaeger UI.

JAEGER_COLLECTOR_HOST_BIND.description: Host bind address for the Jaeger collector.

JAEGER_COLLECTOR_HOST_PORT.description: Host port for the Jaeger collector.

PROMETHEUS_HOST_BIND.description: Host bind address for Prometheus. Keep localhost unless protected.

ALERTMANAGER_HOST_BIND.description: Host bind address for Alertmanager. Keep localhost unless protected.

GRAFANA_HOST_BIND.description: Host bind address for Grafana. Keep localhost unless protected.

FRONTEND_TRUSTED_UPSTREAMS.description: Exact external proxy IP addresses or CIDRs allowed to supply one canonical visitor address.

REDIS_PASSWORD.description: Password for the built-in Redis service. Keep it in sync with REDIS_URL when Redis is bundled.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection URL used by Omlorix for cache, queues, streams, and background jobs.

REDIS_ENABLED.description: Enable Redis-backed runtime features. Most launcher deployments should leave this on.

SETTINGS_CACHE_NAMESPACE.description: Optional deployment identifier used to isolate settings-cache keys when multiple Omlorix deployments intentionally share Redis and a database.

AUTOMATION_QUEUE_NAME.description: Redis queue name used for automation jobs.

PGBOUNCER_POOL_MODE.description: PgBouncer pooling mode. Transaction is the recommended default for most Omlorix deployments.

PGBOUNCER_DEFAULT_POOL_SIZE.description: Default number of PostgreSQL server connections PgBouncer keeps per pool.

PGBOUNCER_RESERVE_POOL_SIZE.description: Extra PgBouncer server connections reserved for short traffic spikes.

MINIO_ROOT_USER.description: Admin username for built-in MinIO object storage.

MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Admin password for built-in MinIO object storage. Use a strong unique secret.

BACKUP_LOCAL_DIR.description: Directory inside the backend container where local backup files are written.

BACKUP_SCHEDULER_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: How often the backup scheduler wakes up to check for due jobs.

BACKUP_WRITE_FREEZE_MAX_SECONDS.description: Maximum time writes may be frozen while creating a consistent backup.

BACKUP_RESTORE_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Maximum time a PostgreSQL restore waits for a relation lock before failing safely.

BACKUP_RESTORE_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Maximum total runtime for each PostgreSQL restore command.

OMLORIX_ERASURE_LEDGER_PATH.description: Path inside the backend container for the restore-resistant completed user-erasure ledger. Leave blank to use Omlorix's persistent data directory; custom paths must use durable storage outside backup replacement.

BACKUP_ARCHIVE_ENCRYPTION_PASSPHRASE.description: Passphrase for encrypted backup archives. Store it separately from backups and keep the original ENCRYPTION_KEY too.

BACKUP_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT_ARCHIVES.description: Allow unencrypted backup archives. Keep disabled except for temporary compatibility scenarios.

FILE_TEMP_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_SECONDS.description: How often temporary file cleanup runs.

FILE_TEMP_MAX_AGE_SECONDS.description: Maximum age for ordinary temporary files before cleanup removes them.

FILE_MATERIALIZED_TEMP_MAX_AGE_SECONDS.description: Maximum age for materialized temporary files before cleanup removes them.

FILE_STORAGE_PROVIDER.description: Storage backend for user uploads when built-in storage is off. Choose local, s3, gcs, azure, or webdav.

FILE_STORAGE_LOCAL_BASE_PATH.description: Local path inside the backend container for user-uploaded files when using local storage.

FILE_STORAGE_S3_BUCKET.description: S3-compatible bucket name for user file storage.

FILE_STORAGE_S3_PREFIX.description: Optional S3 key prefix for all stored user files.

FILE_STORAGE_S3_ENDPOINT_URL.description: Custom S3-compatible endpoint URL, such as MinIO or Cloudflare R2.

FILE_STORAGE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Access key ID for S3-compatible storage.

FILE_STORAGE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret access key for S3-compatible storage.

FILE_STORAGE_S3_SESSION_TOKEN.description: Optional temporary session token for S3-compatible storage.

FILE_STORAGE_GCS_BUCKET.description: Google Cloud Storage bucket name for user files.

FILE_STORAGE_GCS_PREFIX.description: Optional Google Cloud Storage object prefix for all user files.

FILE_STORAGE_GCS_PROJECT.description: Google Cloud project ID for the storage bucket.

FILE_STORAGE_GCS_CREDENTIALS_JSON.description: Service account credentials JSON for Google Cloud Storage. Treat as a secret.

FILE_STORAGE_AZURE_CONTAINER.description: Azure Blob Storage container name for user files.

FILE_STORAGE_AZURE_PREFIX.description: Optional Azure blob prefix for all user files.

FILE_STORAGE_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING.description: Azure Storage connection string. Treat as a secret.

FILE_STORAGE_AZURE_ACCOUNT_URL.description: Azure Storage account URL used when authenticating without a connection string.

FILE_STORAGE_AZURE_CREDENTIAL.description: Azure credential value used with the account URL. Treat as a secret.

FILE_STORAGE_WEBDAV_URL.description: WebDAV endpoint URL for user file storage.

FILE_STORAGE_WEBDAV_USERNAME.description: WebDAV username for user file storage.

FILE_STORAGE_WEBDAV_PASSWORD.description: WebDAV password for user file storage.

FILE_STORAGE_WEBDAV_PREFIX.description: Optional WebDAV path prefix for all user files.

FILE_STORAGE_WEBDAV_VERIFY_SSL.description: Verify TLS certificates when connecting to WebDAV storage. Keep enabled unless using a trusted private certificate setup.

DB_MIGRATIONS_MODE.description: Controls database migrations for this container. Use off for app containers when migrations run in a dedicated job.

DB_MIGRATIONS_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: How long the migration runner waits for the PostgreSQL advisory lock.

POSTGRES_VOLUME_MOUNT_PATH.description: Path where the postgres_data volume is mounted inside the PostgreSQL container.

POSTGRES_PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory inside the mounted volume. Keep stable across upgrades.

MODE.description: Runtime mode. Production disables developer-only API docs; dev enables local development conveniences.

TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS.description: Trust forwarded headers from known reverse proxies so Omlorix can see real visitor IP addresses.

FRONTEND_TRUST_PROXY_HEADERS.description: Preserve an upstream X-Forwarded-For chain at nginx only when the frontend port is restricted to a trusted proxy that overwrites client-supplied forwarding headers.

OMLORIX_DISABLE_IP_RESTRICTIONS.description: Emergency bypass for admin-managed IP restrictions and IP bans. Enable only long enough to recover access.

TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated proxy CIDRs allowed to set X-Forwarded-For. Keep this limited to infrastructure you control.

TRUSTED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated Host header values accepted by the backend in addition to configured public URLs.

UVICORN_FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS.description: Proxy IPs or CIDRs Uvicorn trusts for forwarded headers. Avoid broad private ranges in production.

RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT_RPM.description: Default requests-per-minute limit for routes without a more specific limit.

RATE_LIMIT_WIDGET_FRAME_RPM.description: Requests-per-minute limit for creating interactive widget frames. Keep it high enough to hydrate chats containing multiple widgets while limiting abuse.

RATE_LIMIT_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Optional proxy CIDRs used only by the rate limiter when parsing forwarded visitor IPs.

AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Optional proxy CIDRs used by authentication flows when evaluating forwarded request metadata.

RATE_LIMIT_PROXY_SETTINGS_CACHE_SECONDS.description: How long rate limiting caches proxy trust settings before reloading them.

OTEL_SERVICE_NAME.description: Service name reported in OpenTelemetry traces, metrics, and logs.

OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_INSECURE.description: Allow plaintext OTLP exporter connections. Keep false unless sending to a trusted local collector.

OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG.description: Argument for the selected trace sampler, such as a sampling ratio.

OTEL_PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_ENABLED.description: Expose Prometheus metrics from OpenTelemetry instrumentation.

OTEL_LOGS_ENABLED.description: Enable OpenTelemetry log correlation and export.

OTEL_SQL_COMMENTER_ENABLED.description: Attach SQL comment metadata for observability. Leave off unless your database policy allows it.

OTEL_CAPTURE_HTTP_ROUTE.description: Capture HTTP route attributes in telemetry.

OTEL_CAPTURE_HTTP_USER_AGENT.description: Capture raw User-Agent values in telemetry. This can be privacy-sensitive.

OTEL_HASH_HTTP_USER_AGENT.description: Hash User-Agent values before recording them in telemetry.

GRAFANA_ADMIN_USER.description: Admin username for the bundled Grafana dashboard.

GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Admin password for the bundled Grafana dashboard. Replace the placeholder before enabling observability.
